# Synthetic fixtures

Add small, deterministic, versioned observations and game-input replays when contracts exist. Include seeds, timestep/configuration versions and event ordering needed for scoring reproduction.

Keep participant recordings, biometric data, device identifiers and secrets out of fixtures. Raw videos and model binaries are ignored; if a small synthetic binary fixture becomes necessary, add a narrow reviewed ignore exception with provenance and purpose.

There are no executable fixtures yet. See [replay boundaries](../../docs/coordinates-and-timing.md#replay-boundaries).
